def: Search in which the candidates are programs, scored by running them, so that the result is a procedure rather than a single answer.
A DeepMind system that pairs a code-writing language model with an automatic evaluator and an island-based program database to evolve a single function.
A DeepMind coding agent that evolves marked regions of whole codebases using model-written diffs, staged evaluation and an archive of programs.
Listing earlier programs as numbered versions sorted by score, ending with the header of the next version, so the model continues the improvement.
A population split into sub-populations that evolve separately, so no single family of solutions can take over the whole search.
The tuple of scores a program obtains on a set of test inputs, used to cluster programs that behave alike.
The program that runs a candidate and returns the numbers that define how good it is, and the only definition of better the search has.
Staged testing in which cheap checks reject poor candidates before expensive ones are run.
A set of points in the space of vectors with entries 0, 1 and 2, with no three points on a line.
Packing items that arrive one at a time into fixed-size bins, each placed immediately, using as few bins as possible.
